# Install, daemon, devices and git: is this moment mine?

## What this region is

Getting Foundry installed and kept running on one machine: the macOS LaunchAgent daemon with its agent-CLI PATH, release-based auto-update and last-good settings; interactive setup, doctor and readiness checks; this machine's local device identity and project checkouts; the small git helpers that tell Foundry which repository, branch and worktree it is in.

## What it exists for

- Get Foundry running
- Find claude, codex and node
- Auto-update the daemon onto a new release
- Keep the daemon booting on good settings
- Check the install is healthy
- Get rid of the old starter stack
- First-run configuration
- Know which machine and checkout this is
- Relate checkouts of one project across machines
- Find the right worktree
- Read or set a checkout's git state

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- add a new key to settings.json and save it through the viewer → settings-runtime
- re-record cassettes or run the live test tier → testing-vcr
- which Claude login the daemon's sessions run on → logins-secrets
- authorize this device with Kingdom or pair this Foundry → kingdom
- register a new tool on the foundry MCP bridge → tool-gate-mcp
